title: gen_desc_image.py packs an AUDIO_UNIT that breaks the SET_SAMPLING_RATE image contract (rule L10) without a word
body:
[A10] Found by the whole-project assessment of issue #51 (owner directive of 2026-09-19).
Target: protocol-processor (new issue)


## Objective and evidence

#51's fix makes SET_SAMPLING_RATE walk the AUDIO_UNIT's `sampling_rates` list.
Because a state-port address is an immediate, the walk has two limits, and
07 section 3.1 records them as rule L10:
- The list must sit at `sampling_rates_offset` 144, the value IEEE 1722.1-2021
  section 7.2.3 gives this AEM version. Any other offset refuses every rate.
- The list may hold at most 8 entries. A rate listed past the eighth entry is
  refused.

Both limits fail closed: neither can ever accept an unlisted rate. They can
still refuse a rate the descriptor lists, and that breaks Milan v1.2 section 5.3.3.3
from the other side.

Nothing enforces L10 at build time:
- `hdl/aecp/desc/gen_desc_image.py` checks names, lengths and the line-buffer
  bound (`_check_name_binding`, `_index_runs`), and no descriptor semantics.
- L6 (the clock-source identity list the SET_CLOCK_SOURCE bound relies on) is
  not enforced there either.
- The parent repository builds its shipping image through this packer
  (kebag-logic/milan-fpga `avdecc/gen_aemi_image.py` imports its `build()`), so
  a check here would guard every consumer at once.

## Acceptance

1. `gen_desc_image.py` refuses, with `ImageError` naming the rule, an
   AUDIO_UNIT whose `sampling_rates_offset` is not 144, whose
   `sampling_rates_count` exceeds 8, or whose length is not 144 + 4 x count.
2. The same for L6: a CLOCK_DOMAIN whose `clock_sources` list is not 0..count-1.
3. A negative case per refusal, run by a gate that CI executes (the packer has
   no self-test today; `tb/desc_store` only packs the example).
4. `example_milan_8.json` still packs.

Out of scope: widening the walk (a register-addressed state read would be a
micro-ISA change).

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
